About

A Nairobi operator, running Nairobi days

Nairobi Adventures is a Nairobi-based tour operator offering guided excursions inside the city and single-day tours starting from it, including game drives in Nairobi National Park. We answer our own email, plan our own routes and drive our own days, so the person who confirms your booking is the person who knows what the roads and the wildlife are doing that week.

What we do, stated plainly

Nairobi Adventures builds days rather than packages. Every excursion we sell starts and ends in Nairobi on the same calendar day, which is a deliberate limit: it is the kind of travel that visitors most often need help with and least often find planned properly. A traveller with one free morning, a connecting flight or a rest day between safari legs does not need a multi-day itinerary, they need one day that works.

That focus is why our four excursions cover the whole realistic range of a Nairobi day, from a first-light game drive seven kilometres from the business district to a long run down the Rift Valley escarpment and back before dark.

How we work with guests

Booking starts with a conversation rather than a checkout. You send dates, a pick-up address and who is travelling. We reply with availability, an itemised quote and a suggested running order for that specific day, including the pick-up time we recommend and why. Nothing is confirmed until the plan makes sense to you, because a day tour that starts with a misunderstanding about fees or timing rarely recovers.

Why book direct rather than through a platform

Booking direct puts you in contact with the operator who will actually run your day. Questions about whether a four-hour layover is enough, whether the gorge walk suits your children or whether the flamingos are at Nakuru this month get answered by someone who was on those roads recently, not by a call centre reading a listing. Direct booking also keeps the commission inside the business that provides the service, which is what makes honest, itemised pricing possible.

How we operate

Four rules we hold to

These are the working principles behind every quote and every itinerary we send.

Quote it, do not bundle it

Park entry, transport, guiding and attraction tickets appear as separate lines in your quote, because a single lump sum makes it impossible to see what you are paying for or to drop a stop you do not want.

Say no when the day does not work

If a layover is too tight or a destination is too far to enjoy in the hours available, we say so and propose something that fits. An oversold day produces a bad review and a traveller who misses a flight.

Plan around the fixed points

The elephant orphanage opens for one short window a day and airlines close check-in at a set time. We build every itinerary backwards from constraints like these, so the flexible parts flex and the fixed parts hold.

One party per vehicle

Private departures mean the route, the stops and the pace follow your group rather than a shared timetable, which matters most with young children, photographers and anyone on a schedule.

Talk to the people who will drive your day

Send your dates and questions. You will get a considered reply with a plan, a quote and an honest view of what fits into the time you have.
